data.gender_notes: Bhavik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhavik is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhava', which means 'to be' or 'feeling'. The name signifies the one who embodies emotions and feelings. In Hindu mythology, Bhavik refers to the divine emotions and feelings of the gods. The name Bhavik carries the meaning “Lord of feeling or emotion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhavik usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of feeling or emotion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
